expected.exit_basis: contract-declared placeholder corroborated by the reference child process exit; the product runner ABI is UNBOUND
expected.exit_semantics: A positive case succeeds only if the case child process exits 0 AND the typed token is emitted AND every predicate holds. The engine wrapper exit is not case evidence; exit 0 alone is NOT a product PASS. The product runner ABI is UNBOUND in this set.

predicates.assertion: Two different alternatives are present with different types (existing candidate vs typed ReasonedNA).
Each alternative states both fit and no-fit.
predicates.verify: all(a.fit and a.nofit for a in alternatives)

predicates.assertion: No new root cause is claimed without evidence.
No license or rights claim is made for the original sample.

predicate_contract: Each predicate is independently checkable from the produced case record or from the real filesystem. A token match alone never satisfies the oracle; all predicates must hold.
not_covered: Original sample rights/designation are unavailable. This is a Generic Native alternatives case, not an original-domain designation decision.
freeze_rule: expected-before-observed; this oracle was frozen before the product run; an oracle change requires a CR and a new case revision; an old FAIL is preserved
